questions.title: Sum of Array
questions.statementMd:
Given an array of integers `arr`, return the sum of all its elements.

The sum can be larger than a 32-bit integer, so use a 64-bit type where your language needs one.

**Constraints**

- `1 <= arr.length <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= arr[i] <= 10^9`

python.driver:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    _arr = json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
    print(json.dumps(Solution().arraySum(_arr), separators=(",", ":")))

tests.explanation: A single element is its own sum.

questions.title: Reverse a String
questions.statementMd:
Given a string `s`, return the string with its characters in reverse order.

**Constraints**

- `1 <= s.length <= 100000`
- `s` contains only English letters, digits and spaces.

tests.explanation: Reading hello from right to left gives olleh.
A single character reads the same both ways.
